content: Collection-game progression (cross-checked: Pokemon GO candy system, gacha games, Fire Emblem Heroes): dupes convert to species-specific currency (candy/soul gems/merge shards) used to level, evolve, or strengthen. GO: each catch grants species candy; evolution costs candy; evolved/higher-tier catches grant MORE candy (tier-scaled dupe value); XL candy gates 40-50. IVs are individual stat variance (GO uses 3 stats, ~4000 combos) making every catch unique and dupes useful. Evolution/ascension tiers are level-gated (t1 at L20, t2 at L50 in this design mirrors GO's power-up curve) with end tiers locked behind events/special items to create long-term goals. Fire Emblem Heroes allows low-tier units to be built into monsters via dupes+skills - power comes from investment, not just rarity.
